details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: quadratic runtime in the default-attribute lookup of
     storeAtts(), and an out-of-bounds read in the same lookup for parsers
     created by XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-66046.patch: in lib/xmlparse.c, replace the
       linear scan over ELEMENT_TYPE.defaultAtts in storeAtts() with a lookup
       in the already-present defaultAttForName hash table, and make dtdCopy()
       create NAME_AND_DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTE-sized entries so storeAtts() no
       longer reads member .attIndex past the end of an entry.
     - CVE-2026-66046
   * SECURITY UPDATE: a UTF-16 high surrogate not followed by a low surrogate
     was accepted, letting the high surrogate swallow the following code unit
     and hide it from the tokenizer
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-93990.patch: in lib/xmltok.c, add
       LITTLE2_IS_INVALID_CHAR() / BIG2_IS_INVALID_CHAR() and wire them into
       IS_INVALID_CHAR() for the little2_/big2_ tokenizers, so
       INVALID_LEAD_CASE() in lib/xmltok_impl.c rejects a 4-byte UTF-16
       character whose second code unit is not U+DC00..U+DFFF; drop the now
       unreachable IS_INVALID_CHAR() no-op fallback in lib/xmltok_impl.c.
     - CVE-2026-93990
